# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs-reference.mjs from `randl --help`; do not edit. -->

The `randl` command talks to a server over HTTP, prints JSON on standard output and exits
with a non-zero status after printing the error on standard error. It never prompts.

- **Server:** `--url`, else `RANDL_URL`, else `http://127.0.0.1:8742`.
- **Key:** `RANDL_API_KEY`, sent as a bearer token, when the server has one.
- **Running it:** `npm run randl -- …` from the repository, or `node /path/to/randl/backend/dist/cli.js …`.
  The docs write `randl …`; `alias randl="node $PWD/backend/dist/cli.js"` makes that work.

Most commands call one tool from the [tool reference](tools.md); `randl tool NAME --json ARGS`
calls any tool with every argument it takes, including ones a command has no flag for.
Comma-separated flags (`--ids`, `--tags`, `--gpus`, `--cite`) take lists; flags ending in
`-file` read a file, or standard input for `-`.

```text
randl — rewards and losses

randl serve [--port 8742] [--data-dir .data] [--pi-agent-dir DIR] [--frontend-dir DIR] [--host 127.0.0.1] [--run-timeout 600] [--public-url https://randl.example.com] [--entity local]
  --entity (or RANDL_ENTITY) is the W&B entity the SDK uses when wandb.init() names none.
randl status
randl runs [--project entity/project]
randl runs show --id entity/project/run
randl runs delete|restore|stop|add-tags|remove-tags --ids run1,run2 [--tags tag1,tag2]
randl runs update-meta --id entity/project/run [--config JSON | --config-file PATH|-] [--merge JSON | --merge-file PATH|-] [--tags a,b] [--add-tags a,b] [--remove-tags a,b] [--summary JSON] [--notes TEXT] [--by NAME]
  --config replaces top-level config keys (null removes one); --merge deep-merges objects into them; --summary sets summary keys. State, history and files are untouched.
randl runs set-state --id entity/project/run --state stopped|finished|failed|crashed [--reason TEXT] [--by NAME] [--dry-run]
  Marks a run that has ended as stopped on purpose (or back); a running run is refused.
randl runs rename-metrics --id entity/project/run --rename old=new[,old2=new2] [--combine] [--dry-run] [--by NAME]
randl runs rename-metrics --undo ID
  Renames metric keys in history, summary and the metric index; --combine merges into existing keys. Prints undo IDs.
randl runs write-history --id entity/project/run --rows JSON | --rows-file PATH|- [--replace] [--dry-run] [--by NAME]
  Rows are [{"match": {"update": 473000}, "values": {"metric": 0.7}}] or use "step"; each merges into one history record.
randl projects list|show|create|rename|describe|archive|restore|delete --id entity/project [--name Name] [--description TEXT | --description-file PATH|-] [--confirm Name]
randl views list|get|create|rename|delete [--id ID] [--name Name] [--project entity/project]
randl panels add|update|remove --view ID [--id PANEL_ID] [--plugin line] [--metric loss] [--metrics loss,reward] [--expressions JSON]
  --expressions takes a JSON array of computed metrics, e.g. '[{"name":"Rate","expression":"${hits} / ${total}"}]'; [] or null on update removes them.
randl select --view ID [--visible run1,run2 | --visible-file PATH] [--solo run1,run2 | --solo-file PATH]
  Files contain a JSON array of run IDs; use - to read one array from standard input. Up to 100,000 unique IDs per selection.
randl plugins list|install|update|enable|disable|remove [--source PATH_OR_GITHUB_URL] [--id ID]
randl artifacts list|show|log|download|alias [--id ID] [--path PATH] [--name NAME] [--project entity/project] [--type dataset] [--alias latest] [--output DIR]
randl findings list|get|save|delete --project entity/project [--id ID] [--run RUN] [--topic T] [--title T] [--status finding|ruled_out] [--body TEXT | --body-file PATH|-] [--cite RUN[@UPDATE],…] [--by NAME]
randl recipe get|set --project entity/project [--run RUN --reason TEXT [--since DATE]] [--by NAME]
randl plans list|save|delete --project entity/project [--id ID] [--name NAME] [--json '{"resources":{"gpus":2,"min_memory_gb":48},"queue":1,"resume_run":"…"}'] [--config-yaml-file PATH|-] [--by NAME]
randl plans queue --project entity/project
randl plans claim --project entity/project --host HOST --free-gpus 3,4,5 --by AGENT [--dry-run]
  claim gives the first waiting plan whose GPU request fits the host's free GPUs those GPUs, and prints it with gpu_ids (config_yaml verbatim), or plan null.
randl plans move --project entity/project --id ID [--before ID | --after ID] [--by NAME]
randl gpus list|save|delete --project entity/project [--host HOST --gpus 0,1,2 [--model 'RTX 4090'] [--memory-gb 24] [--reserved | --allowed] [--note TEXT] [--replace]] [--by NAME]
  The project's GPU inventory; --reserved lists GPUs that are never allocated.
randl ideas list|save|delete|promote|from-plan --project entity/project [--id ID] [--title T] [--priority high|medium|low] [--status open|dropped] [--plan PLAN] [--json '{"hypothesis":"…","evidence":"…","waits_on":[{"kind":"run","id":"…"}]}'] [--by NAME] [--dry-run]
  promote makes a plan from an idea (--plan names it, --json adds plan fields such as resources); from-plan turns a waiting plan into an idea and removes the plan.
randl journal list|add [--run RUN | --project entity/project] [--text TEXT] [--update N] [--step N] [--time DATE] [--key KEY] [--by NAME]
randl tools
randl tool NAME --json '{"arguments":"value"}'
randl agent 'Manage my workspace' [--session ID] [--confirm-delete-project entity/project]

Global: --url http://127.0.0.1:8742. Outputs JSON. Plugin enable runs trusted frontend code.
```
